title: AIAS Engineering Operating System
purpose: Coordinate operational AIAS services through a dependency-aware, evidence-gated and event-driven project lifecycle.
scope: Service topology, health, project lifecycle, sequential gates, idempotent commands, correlation, evidence, audit hashes and CNS event integration.

requirements.title: Service topology
requirements.statement: AEOS shall register versioned capabilities, dependencies and explicit service health.
requirements.rationale: Make the digital company operationally observable.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Lifecycle kernel
requirements.statement: Projects shall advance sequentially from INITIATED through OPERATING.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Evidence gates
requirements.statement: Every target state shall require its service readiness and mandatory evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reliable commands
requirements.statement: Commands shall be correlated, idempotent, atomically persisted and hash-audited.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate consumer
requirements.statement: The full Lighthouse lifecycle shall reach OPERATING and publish real CNS journal events.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: AEOS shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
